description: This Kotlin test file contains unit tests for the NotificationForwardingPolicy class, testing parsing of time strings, package filtering policies, quiet hours handling, and rate limiting features.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for NotificationForwardingPolicy, covering parsing, filtering policies, quiet hours, and rate limiting functionalities.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_parsesValidValues
methods.description: Tests parsing of valid 'HH:MM' strings into minute representations.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_acceptsStrict24HourDrafts
methods.description: Ensures that valid 'HH:MM' formats are normalized correctly.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_rejectsInvalidValues
methods.description: Verifies that invalid time strings are rejected by returning null.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_rejectsNonCanonicalDrafts
methods.description: Checks that non-canonical or malformed time strings are rejected in normalization.

methods.name: allowsPackage_blocklistBlocksConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Tests that blocklist policy correctly blocks configured packages.

methods.name: allowsPackage_allowlistOnlyAllowsConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Verifies that allowlist policy permits only specified packages.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_handlesWindowCrossingMidnight
methods.description: Tests if quiet hours detection correctly handles windows crossing midnight.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_sameStartEndMeansAlwaysQuiet
methods.description: Checks behavior when quiet start and end are the same, meaning always quiet.

methods.name: blocksEventsWhenDisabledOrQuietHoursOrRateLimited
methods.description: Ensures notification events are blocked when policy is disabled, during quiet hours, or rate-limited.

methods.name: burstLimiter_blocksEventsAboveLimitInSameMinute
methods.description: Verifies the rate limiter blocks events exceeding the per-minute limit within the same time window.

methods.name: burstLimiter_resetsOnNextMinuteWindow
methods.description: Ensures the rate limiter resets count after a minute window has passed.
